description: Classify a software engineering request made to a coding assistant.

taxonomy.planning: Deciding scope, architecture, or task breakdown before writing code.
taxonomy.refactoring: Restructuring or cleaning up existing working code without changing its behavior.
taxonomy.testing: Writing, fixing, or improving coverage of automated tests.
taxonomy.fix: A concrete bug, crash, or incorrect behavior that needs correcting.
taxonomy.documentation: Writing or updating docstrings, comments, README, or API docs.
taxonomy.other: Multiple categories apply with no clear primary one, or the request is out of scope for these categories.
